question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Approach
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Approach"** means to come near or nearer to someone or something in distance or time. (निकट आना)

 
 
• **Example: **As you **approach** the city, you will see the skyline come into view.
 
 
 
• **"Withdraw" **means to move back or away from a place or situation; to retreat. (वापस लेना)
 
 
• **Example: **He decided to **withdraw** from the competition due to health issues.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Approach' **is **'Withdraw'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restore **(पुनःस्थापित करना): To bring back or re-establish a previous right, practice, or situation.

 
 
• **Example:** The government plans to restore the old building to its original state.
 
 
 
• **Advance **(अग्रसर होना): To move forward or make progress.
 
 
• **Example: **The troops continued to advance despite heavy opposition.
 
 
 
• **Mollify** (शांत करना): To appease the anger or anxiety of someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager tried to mollify the unhappy customer with a refund.
 
 

35:Tcb9,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
